name: tvdoctor-monorepo
description: Automated QA for TV apps and 10-foot user interfaces.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:fixture
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fixture && npm run test:driver && npm run test:core-integration && npm run test:report-integration && npm run test:streaming-integration && npm run test:cli-integration
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && npm run typecheck --workspace @tvdoctor/broken-streaming-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @tvdoctor/driver-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @tvdoctor/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @tvdoctor/pack-streaming && npm run typecheck --workspace @tvdoctor/reporters
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:presentation && npm run test && npm run build
